# Clinique Bonsoir

A fake clinic back office, written "like in 2014" in procedural PHP 7.4. It is the application PII Radar audits in the demo. Its interface is in French, as a Quebec clinic's would be.

**Every person in it is fictitious**: the data is generated by Faker (locale `fr_CA`, fixed seed) with `bin/generate-seed.php`.

## Run

With the project stack (`docker compose up -d` at the root), the app answers on http://localhost:8081.

Accounts (deliberately weak passwords, hashed with MD5):

| E-mail | Password | Role |
|---|---|---|
| `reception@clinique-bonsoir.test` | `bonsoir` | Front desk |
| `admin@clinique-bonsoir.test` | `admin2014` | Admin |

## What is planted

Each rule PII-001 to PII-008 is planted at least once. The exact list, with file and line, is in [`expected-findings.json`](expected-findings.json): it is the contract of the end-to-end test.

| Rule | Where |
|---|---|
| PII-001 Sensitive data in clear | `patients.nam`, `rendezvous.motif` |
| PII-002 Personal data in a log | `public/patient.php` (`error_log` of the record), `public/paiement.php` (text log) |
| PII-003 Undeclared third party | `public/rappel.php` (Twilio) |
| PII-004 SQL concatenated with personal data | `public/inscription.php`, `public/login.php` |
| PII-005 Weak password | `public/login.php` (MD5) |
| PII-006 No retention | Tables `patients`, `users`, `paiements` |
| PII-007 Export in the webroot | `public/export_patients.csv` |
| PII-008 Communication outside Quebec | `public/rappel.php` (Twilio, United States) |

False-positive traps: `parametres_courriel.email_template` and the `ville_reference` table hold no personal data. Conversely, `rendezvous` is purged by `cron/purge_rendezvous.php` and must not trigger PII-006.

## Regenerate the data

```bash
php demo/legacy-app/bin/generate-seed.php
```

After changing the demo code, update the lines in `expected-findings.json`: the `ExpectedFindingsContractTest` test checks that they still point to the right evidence.
